data.investment_objective:
The investment objective of the scheme is to provide returns that, before expenses, correspond to the total
returns of the securities as represented by Nifty MidSmall India Consumption Total Return Index, subject to
tracking error.
However, there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objectives of the scheme will be achieved.

Constituents of Nifty MidSmall India Consumption Index - 95 -100 %
Units of Liquid schemes and Money Market instruments - 0 - 5%
data.benchmark: Nifty MidSmall India Consumption Total Return Index
data.exit_load:
1% if redeemed on or before 15 days of allotment,
Nil - If redeemed after 15 days from the date of allotment
